Hi Olivia — Marissa from Redwood legal. Appreciate the clear asks; below is proposed contract language and operational commitments we believe are a reasonable compromise. I'm pasting the operational paragraphs (feel free to copy into your redlines).

1) Key Management (proposed):
"For Dedicated and Private deployments, Redwood will support customer-managed keys (BYOK) integrated via customer KMS endpoints (e.g., AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault). For the Redwood Hosted service, Redwood will provide customer-scoped envelope encryption using Redwood-managed FIPS-validated HSMs. Redwood will provide (i) exportable key usage logs, (ii) quarterly key-rotation attestations, and (iii) upon reasonable audit request, evidence of key management controls. Customer-managed-hosted-key integrations for Hosted will be considered on a case-by-case basis and may require a commercial addendum."

2) Subprocessor notification (proposed):
"Redwood will publish an up-to-date list of subprocessors in the customer portal and will notify customers by email at least 15 calendar days prior to the onboarding of a new subprocessor that Redwood reasonably considers critical for data processing. For critical financial-sector customers who require 30 days' notice, Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to accommodate such notice periods via contract addendum."

3) TOMs — key rotation & backups (proposed):
"Redwood rotates master envelope keys no less frequently than every 12 months; data-encryption keys supporting customer data are rotated at customer-configurable intervals with a default of 90 days. Encrypted backups are protected under the same envelope encryption scheme; decryption privileges are limited to a restricted set of Redwood operations principals under dual-authorization controls and recorded in immutable audit logs."

We attached a version of the DPA with these paragraphs inserted. If that language is acceptable in principle, we can produce a tracked DocuSign envelope with the agreed redlines.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

- Hosted BYOK: StellarBank's internal auditors are asking if we can have the option to bring keys for hosted workloads provided Redwood implements a hardened integration model (per-tenant envelope keys, restricted human access, independent attestations). If Redwood cannot reasonably support BYOK for Hosted, we will need to document compensating controls in the contract (e.g., SOC2 + KMS attestation + more frequent rotation).
- Subprocessor notice: okay on 15 days with an addendum offering 30 days for critical categories. Please make the portal-sourced list the authoritative record in the contract.
- DocuSign: legal is ready to sign once we have explicit language on the hosted compensating controls. Can you (a) confirm the DocuSign envelope will include the TOMs exhibit PDF, and (b) provide a contact for audit evidence requests?

If helpful, we can accept an executed envelope that includes a statement that Redwood will provide, within 30 days of request, copies of SOC reports and a KMS controls attestation.

Olivia — Karthik from Security/Compliance here. We discussed internally and proposed the following operational compromise that should satisfy auditors while keeping Hosted a stable product:

- Hosted: we will not support full BYOK for multi-tenant hosted customers at launch, but will implement per-tenant envelope keys (customer-scoped DEKs derived from service-managed master keys), strict role separation, quarterly independent attestation of KMS controls, and the option to enable additional logging/export for auditors. We will contractually commit to providing SOC2 reports and a KMS controls attestation within 30 days of a reasonable request.
- Dedicated/Private: full BYOK support via customer KMS endpoints/HSM integration as Marissa outlined.
- Subprocessors: the portal will be the authoritative list; Redwood will email security contacts on new critical subprocessors at least 15 days prior. For customers that require longer notice, we will add a contract addendum.

I've updated the TOMs exhibit (attached) with the rotation and privileged-access language. If the above is acceptable, Sergio will create a DocuSign envelope that includes the DPA + TOMs exhibit and the audit evidence statement. Please confirm and we will send the envelope today.
